g.text: LyonRank4Convo4 begins.
I realized I know very little about where you came from, or how you grew up. Would you be willing to tell me anything?
[Warning: Brief mention of child abuse. Click here to end. No Chemistry loss with Lyon will be incurred.]
Evaluate expressions
+20 Chemistry

I fear it is not a terribly pleasant story to tell. I told you of the visions that sent me to the Cathedral to worship the Luminaries, and the grandparents who met during the Gaullique Revolution. Are you certain you wish to waste your time with such things?
LyonBackstory1, LyonBackstory2
I fear it is not a terribly pleasant story to tell. I told you of the visions that sent me to the Cathedral to worship the Luminaries. Are you certain you wish to waste your time with such things?
LyonBackstory1
I fear it is not a terribly pleasant story to tell. I told you of the grandparents who met during the Gaullique Revolution. Are you certain you wish to waste your time with such things?
LyonBackstory2
我恐怕這不是什麼令人高興的故事。你確定要把時間浪費在這種事情上嗎？
false
Chat ends.
你為什麼會覺得這是在浪費時間？
對我來說，這不是浪費時間，里昂。我真的很想更了解你。
那算了。如果你不想的話。
I would simply think there are better ways for you to spend your energies. Such as defending some bastion against an encroaching enemy party, discovering unknown knowledge... or sorting clothing.
Evaluate expressions
No, forgive me. I... apologize for how poorly I am handling all this.
里昂，如果你希望我離開的話，請直接說。
你這樣只會讓事情變得更差。
+5 Chemistry
LyonFirstFlirt
現在決定好方向了嗎？還是說，你的神經比我更脆弱？
LyonFlirtIgnored
+5 Chemistry
false
I am not quite often certain how one is to properly respond in situations such as simple curiosity over one's history - or even benign expressions of friendship.
+5 Chemistry
Yes, and it is this... sentiment that makes me increasingly trepidatious, I must admit. For my peace of mind, simply confirm for me that you mean what I am more and more increasingly fear you might.
很抱歉之前冷落你……
你是什麼意思……？
我要說實話……你用的措辭讓我有些不安。雖然我不知道你的意思是否跟我理解的一樣。
不管怎樣 — 你是在打聽我的過去，對吧？
那我就讓你放心吧 — 我對你沒有任何感覺。
里昂，你就這麼難相信我對你有感覺嗎？
You abandoned the pursuit with as much fervor as you began it. I assumed you had rightly decided it was a poor decision.
你可能已經留意到，我能看見……異象。自我還是個小孩子的時候，這就是我生活的一部分。
I did not mean to rebuff you, but it is good to know where we stand. I... apologize for how poorly I am handling all this.
Update boolean DrifterLyon
你說得對，這一切都是個錯誤。
我只是不確定我有沒有不請自來。
這些異象，說得委婉點，往往都不是什麼令人愉快的景象。
Simply put? Well, yes. I... do not mean to rebuff your efforts. I am simply... unaccustomed... to affection, Drifter. Of any sort.
I thought as much. I will therefore simply wish you a good rest of your day.
+5 Chemistry
And you think the visions came from Lua?
具體有什麼？
它們有嚇到你嗎？
If you are set upon this path, I shall not deter you and I... I have found as unsettled and... foreign to me as this is?
Chat ends.
They are not... unwelcome, per se? They simply are... perplexing, in the fact that they exist at all.
I once awoke in the middle of the night to the visage of an old woman sitting at the foot of my bed.
I once awoke in the middle of the night to the visage of an old woman sitting at the foot of my bed.
+5 Chemistry
你希望我停下嗎？
So thin and frail that she might have already been dead and buried for years, her skin clung to her bones so tight that I could see the spaces between them.
So thin and frail that she might have already been dead and buried for years, her skin clung to her bones so tight that I could see the spaces between them.
I am... perhaps, cautiously hopeful to see where this new path leads. However - you were enquiring as to my past, yes?
No, I... do not mean to rebuff your efforts. I am simply... unaccustomed... to affection, Drifter. Of any sort.
Her hair was barely more than a few wisps of white that hung limply from her head. But it was her eyes that I will remember most.
Her hair was barely more than a few wisps of white that hung limply from her head. But it was her eyes that I will remember most.
Update boolean LyonFlirt2
For she had none at all.
For she had none at all.
Three months later, a woman in the village was discovered dead in her home. Her eyes, devoured by rats.
三個月後，村裡一名婦女被發現死在家中，雙眼被老鼠啃噬清光。
我把那天晚上醒來時看到的異象告訴了母親。她也記得我看到的，和我一樣。
是的，漂泊者。那些異象嚇到我了。
她做了什麼？
她當時認為這是巧合，還是某種預兆？
She beat me with a switch until I could no longer stand. My back would bleed until I would be forced to sleep lying face down. I still recall her screams as she would strike me. "Diable ! Sorcier !"

I do not know. All I know is she beat me with a switch until I could not longer stand. My back would bleed until I would be forced to sleep lying face down. I still recall her screams as she would strike me. "Diable ! Sorcier !"
你當時幾歲？
噢，里昂……我真的，真的很難過……
太可憐了……
當時她很無知，她不知道該怎樣處理。
或許四歲吧。最多六歲。我不知道。我們那時候不像你們現在這樣熱衷於記錄過往。
+5 Chemistry
Check boolean LyonPainOff
我們離開故土來這裡的時候，我母親早已過世。如今，她也化作了塵土。她一生飽受苦難……而且注定要將苦難散播下去。
傷害一個孩童……這是不可寬恕的。
true
false
所以這就是原因為什麼你……？
false
她很害怕。無論我患了什麼病，無論是神明的重擔，瘋狂，或是詛咒，她都無法應對。
Check boolean LyonLecture2
然而，即便我母親再殘忍，也不及我父親。細節我就不贅述了。
或許吧。我常常在想，這會不會是某種強迫症的一部分。但正如我之前跟你說過的，這也是太陰的一種方法。
true
或許吧。我常常在想，這會不會是某種強迫症的一部分。但這也是太陰的一種方法。是聖光者的修行方法。我並非唯一實踐這種方法的人。
false
隨著年齡增長，那些異象變成了聲音。那些低語不時在我耳邊響起，無論醒著還是在夢裡。我的農務因此受到影響，而我本身也飽受折磨。
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
是什麼讓你參加教會？
有些人不配當父母。
我向你堅持說明，這件事確實為我帶來了一絲安寧，儘管我也知道，對你而言，這依然顯得有些難以理解。
It was taught to me by one of the other Fathers at the Cathedral, to help me... clear my mind. Those who are chosen by Lua are often "blessed" by "visions."
Check boolean LyonPainOff
我很感激你的好意，但我亦不能低估我小時候有多難管教，尤其是我比他們更高更強大之後。
Update boolean LyonLecture2
漂泊者，我的幻象和聲音常常讓我陷入暴怒發作。折磨自己往往是我唯一能從那些畫面中醒來的方法。
true
漂泊者，我的幻象和聲音常常讓我陷入暴怒發作。我常常會拿刀割傷自己的軀體，因為只有疼痛才能讓我從痛苦中醒來。
false
但就在那時候那些聲音指引我到
我……我做不到。我真的做不到。對不起。我打字的時候雙手都在顫抖。我現在一定要停下來。
當然。沒關係。不急。我隨時都在這裏，只要你準備好。
我知道，這已經太多了。好好休息吧，好嗎？還有……謝謝你。這對我來說很重要。
+10 Chemistry
+15 Chemistry
謝謝。我再找你。
我想，這對我的意義超過你的想像。朋友，也謝謝你。我們很快再說。
Update boolean LyonBackstory3b
Update boolean LyonBackstory3a
-F. Lyon Allard
Chat ends.
